requirements.evidence_summary: Native TUI real model: three questions, rejected malformed attempts, ready revision 2, unconfirmed and no Run. CLI/MCP contract tests cover missing fields and denied start.
Goal/Run states separate. Budget, final failure, dependency failure and pause outcomes are tested; development gain stopping was corrected after formal Harness ended.
TUI/MCP and CLI share GoalService and independent worker; real worker idempotency plus NDJSON protocol verified.

Evaluation/build/selection checkpoints survive interruption; deterministic duplicate-descriptor case fixed; actual browser dependency blocked -> restored -> achieved on the same revision with zero model calls.
Task inputs, verifier, model, runtime config/binary content, baseline and Skill snapshots frozen; final input freshness checks all exposed revisions.
Target component/path constraints and sandbox sibling data denial verified.
Native DSH method loading in all formal Skill proposals; independent A-derived Skill capability check read one checklist and ran the scenario script successfully.
Source mutation/deletion preserves content snapshots; new versions do not overwrite old packages.
Model-written A development method packaged after a recorded 600-second timeout; nine synthetic scenarios validated, explicit CLI activation and provenance preserved; no hidden final detail input.
All six Goals achieved; median -30.5%, two pairs slower, total +16.9%; one-time costs additional and fees/human/token totals unverified.
Independent final closes search; missing/nonfinite evidence fails closed; timeout/dependency errors do not imply acceptance.
Real browser checks confirm current states, independent final metrics and actual time axis, strict resource counts, lifecycle and downstream report; failed preview errors preserved separately.
Submit/status/cancel/resume/idempotency and parent/checkpoint relation tested with simulated backend; real training explicitly unsupported.
Artifact quality passed. Harness gain +6.67pp failed +10pp gate. Skill median gate passed but aggregate time regressed and complete efficiency gate unproven.

limitations: No real model training was attempted.
Exact token/fee/human costs are unverified; revision elapsed time is not total delivery time.
The original formal Harness used frozen pre-fix implementation; later stopping/contract fixes do not alter its outcome.
Formal Skill production sessions loaded method text but did not read or execute auxiliary resources; separate capability verification proves availability only.
The first failure cause in the old control-pair-3 retry was not retained; reported unknown. New executions retain failed-attempt events.
The original intermittent lock failure descriptor provenance was unknown; an equivalent deterministic inherited-descriptor case was reproduced and fixed.
